question: APP内销量最高的商品是什么
gold_sql: select p.product_name from order_items oi join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id join channels c on o.channel_id = c.channel_id where c.channel_name = 'APP' AND o.status = '已完成' group by p.product_name order by sum(oi.quantity) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT p.product_name
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN channels c ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
WHERE c.channel_name = 'APP'
  AND o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1;
